lane:
مَلْبَسٌ : see لِبَاسٌ. === مَا فِى فَلَانٍ مَلْبَسٌ ‡ _There is no profit_ (مُسْتَمْتَعٌ) _in such a one,_ (S, M, A, [but in the M and A, مَا is omitted, and the only explanation is the word which I have given in Arabic.]) === إِنَّ فِيهِ لَمَلْبَسًا _Verily in him is no pride,_ or _greatness;_ expl. by مَا بِهِ كِبْرٌ, or كِبرٌ, accord. to different authorities [and different copies of the K]: this explanation is by AZ. (TA.) === أَعْرَضَ ثَوْبُ المَلْبَسِ and ↓المِلْبَسِ and ↓المُلْبِسِ (IAar, K) and ↓المُلْتَبِسِ: (TA:) see عَرُضَ, under which it is explained.

مُلْبِسٌ : see مُلْتَبِسٌ: and مَلْبَسٌ.

مِلْبَسٌ : see لِبَاسٌ: and مَلْبَسٌ.

مُلَبِّسٌ : see لَبَّاسٌ.

مُلَبَّسٌ pl. مُلَبَّسَات _Sugared almonds, &c._
